claims.content: Subject competence (Fachkompetenz) is the ability, skill and readiness to observe and analyse psychological and social phenomena using various psychological methods, models or theories.
claims.cited_text: Unter Fachkompetenz wird die Fähigkeit, Fertigkeit und Bereitschaft verstanden

claims.content: Method competence (Methodenkompetenz) is the readiness and ability for goal-directed and systematic procedure in working on questions and problems.
claims.cited_text:
Unter Methodenkompetenz wird die Bereitschaft und Befähigung zu zielgerichtetem 
und planmäßigem Vorgehen

claims.content: Judgement competence (Urteilskompetenz) is the ability to make independent evaluations on psychological questions and to critically reflect on positions and one's own judgement process.
claims.cited_text: Unter Urteilskompetenz wird die Fähigkeit, Fertigkeit und Bereitschaft verstanden

claims.content: Action competence (Handlungskompetenz) is the ability to constructively apply psychological insights to social situations and one's own life; case examples are used to practise it.
claims.cited_text: Unter Handlungskompetenz wird die Fähigkeit, Fertigkeit und Bereitschaft verstanden

claims.content: Subject competence includes systematically observing and precisely perceiving psychological and social phenomena.
claims.cited_text:
Psychische und soziale Phänomene und Probleme systematisch beobachten und ge-
nau wahrnehmen

claims.content: Subject competence includes describing, explaining and comparing psychological phenomena using adequate technical terminology, theories and models.

claims.content: Method competence includes searching for and identifying relevant psychological sources in analogue and digital environments using targeted search strategies and correct citations.

gen unter Anwendung zielgerichteter Suchstrategien

claims.content: Judgement competence includes representing one's own and others' values, positions and interests regarding psychological phenomena in analogue and digital environments.

claims.content: Action competence includes consciously and reflectively adjusting one's behaviour to others in social situations.

claims.content: Action competence includes planning one's own further life path in a psychologically grounded way.
